results.title: Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Farooq Abdullah and other INDIA bloc leaders reach Ramlila Maidan
results.content: INDIA bloc leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, and Farooq Abdullah, arrived at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan to spearhead the ‘Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao’ protest march. Thousands of supporters converged on the national capital to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities and mass voter deletions.

results.title: ‘You can break a stick, not a bundle’: Thousands turn up for INDIA bloc rally from across the country
results.content: Citizens, youth groups, farmers and political party workers gather ahead of the Ramlila Maidan rally, saying a united movement is needed to fight alleged vote theft and electoral roll irregularities

results.title: ‘Remove Modi to save democracy’: Congress chief Kharge attacks PM at INDIA bloc rally
results.content: Addressing INDIA bloc's rally at Ramlila Maidan on the "vote chori" charge, Mr. Kharge also accused Prime Minister Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah of shielding Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar
